translations.web: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
translations.bsb: He reveals the deep and hidden things; He knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with Him.
translations.kjv: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him.
